about: Built by scripts/build-corpus.ts from the source corpus and config/forge-system-prompt.md; do not edit by hand. Holds only what v1 publishes: TRC rows and text (CC BY 4.0), plain-words glosses, quadras, Enneagram label words and the pattern list.

trc.title: Temporal Reference Cognition (TRC)
trc.author: Gourav Kumar Mallick
trc.notice: The TRC rows, function taglines and stack definitions come from Temporal Reference Cognition by Gourav Kumar Mallick (Parul University), licensed CC BY 4.0. The plain-words glosses and template wording are Forge's own, not part of TRC.

Si.plain: going back to what you've lived through
Si.doing: going back to what you've lived through

Se.plain: all in on what's in front of you right now
Se.doing: being all in on what's in front of you right now

Ni.tagline: Eternal Vision / Imagined Evolution of Ideas

Ne.plain: seeing what else something could become
Ne.doing: seeing what else something could become

Ti.plain: it has to make sense by your own logic
Ti.doing: making sure it makes sense by your own logic

Te.plain: going by what works and what the facts show
Te.doing: going by what works and what the facts show

Fi.plain: your own sense of what matters, and where you stand with each person
Fi.doing: going by your own sense of what matters

Fe.plain: the mood and shared values of the people around you
Fe.doing: reading the room and what your people value

lens.plain: how you take things in first
lens.trc: Primary function used by a subject to color its world view, running most of the time yet utilizing least of its energy, and defines their core processing style.

tool.trc: Supporting function to the primary function (lens), acting as an enabling tool for execution and refinement utility to it.

spark.plain: what comes and goes, and refuels you
spark.trc: An inconsistent function used as an escape mechanism, appearing as a balancing function when lens and tool are overused for long periods.

drain.plain: what costs you the most energy
drain.trc: Unconsciously suppressed function, repressed to let the primary function (lens) do its work. Sometimes appears for brief period of time yet most energy-expensive.

P01.name: lived_memory_anchor
P01.plain: decides from specific things they lived through
P01.label: leaning on what you've lived
P01.doing: going back to what you've lived through

P02.name: present_immersion
P02.plain: lives in the moment, very aware of what's going on around them
P02.label: being all in on the moment
P02.doing: being all in on what's in front of you right now

P03.name: inner_trajectory
P03.plain: sees where things are heading, one long inner arc
P03.label: seeing where it's heading

P04.name: outward_branching
P04.plain: many possibilities from one spark, hopping between them
P04.label: seeing what else it could be
P04.doing: seeing what else something could become

P05.name: internal_logical_frame
P05.plain: judges by their own standard of what's logically consistent
P05.label: making it make sense to you
P05.doing: making sure it makes sense by your own logic

P06.name: external_results_frame
P06.plain: judges by what works in the visible world, results and numbers
P06.label: going by what works
P06.doing: going by what works and what the facts show

P07.name: inner_value_anchor
P07.plain: a quiet private sense of what matters and what's acceptable
P07.label: your own sense of what matters
P07.doing: going by your own sense of what matters

P08.name: shared_atmosphere
P08.plain: goes by what the group values and adjusts to keep accord
P08.label: the mood of the room
P08.doing: reading the room and what your people value

P09.name: internal_reference_drift
P09.plain: their frame holds steady inside them and updates slowly
P09.label: a frame that holds steady
P09.doing: keeping a frame that holds steady inside you

P10.name: external_reference_drift
P10.plain: their frame updates from the latest outside input
P10.label: a frame that updates fast
P10.doing: updating fast from what's newest around you

P11.name: enneagram_fixation_signature
P11.plain: one thought pattern keeps coming back across parts of life
P11.label: a thought that keeps coming back

P12.name: enneagram_passion_signature
P12.plain: one drive keeps showing up behind decisions
P12.label: a drive that keeps showing up

P13.name: subtype_instinctual_focus
P13.plain: attention goes first to food, health and home (self_preservative), place in the group (social), or one intense bond (sexual; say "one-to-one" out loud)
P13.label: where your attention goes first

P14.name: stress_signature
P14.plain: what restores them points to the spark; what costs them the most points to the drain
P14.label: what drains you, what refuels you
